definitions: Operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle.
Propel or carry along, especially by force.
Force (someone or something) to move in a particular direction.
Cause (someone or something) to reach a specified state or to do something.
Hit (a ball or shuttlecock) hard and low.
Cause (a machine or process) to operate.
examples: The wind drove the rain against the windows.
They drove the cattle to new pastures.
The noise was driving me mad.
She drove the ball into the net.
They drove a tunnel through the mountain.
